We all know that much of the appeal of social media is being heard and acknowledged. But this new “social” platform takes engagement to a whole new level.

SocialAI on iOS is a new option that lets you pick the type of people who follow you. Except they’re not “people” — they’re AI bots created for the sole purpose of interacting with you.

That’s right — the “users” that respond to you are 100% powered by artificial intelligence.

As someone who is both curious and skeptical about AI, I had to try it out. I created a profile (and a profile image using Midjourney) in seconds, and then posted my first message. Then I waited a few moments.
